He played [[college basketball]] for the [[University of Miami]] in Florida. ==High school career== Born in Boston, he eventually moved to [[Wakefield, Massachusetts|Wakefield]], a suburb of Boston and attended Wakefield High before transferring to Vermont Academy.{{Cite news|url=http://www.bostonherald.com/sports/high_school/high_school_insider/2015/11/prep_basketball_former_wakefield_high_star_bruce|title=PREP BASKETBALL: Former Wakefield High star Bruce Brown commits to Miami|access-date=2018-04-02|language=en}} There, he was able to get offers from many high majors and mid majors yet committed to [[Miami Hurricanes men's basketball|Miami]] as an 5 star recruit by 247 Sports and ranked 26th by ESPN.{{Cite web|url=http://www.espn.com/college-sports/basketball/recruiting/player/_/id/165875/bruce-brown|title=Bruce Brown - Basketball Recruiting - Player Profiles - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=April 2, 2018}} ==College career== As a sophomore, Brown averaged 11.4 points, 7.1 rebounds, and four assists per game and shot 27 percent from 3-point range.{{cite news|last1=McMillen|first1=Gabrielle|title=Miami G Bruce Brown Jr. undergoing surgery on left foot|url=http://www.sportingnews.com/ncaa-basketball/news/miami-hurricanes-guard-bruce-brown-surgery-left-foot-timeline-out-six-weeks/qfg8ceyayrfr1b1vlijonybwz|accessdate=April 2, 2018|work=[[Sporting News]]|date=January 30, 2018}} He only played 19 games and missed the postseason with a left foot injury that required surgery. After the season Brown declared for the [[2018 NBA draft]] but did not hire an agent, thereby allowing for the possibility of returning to college.{{cite news|title=Miami Hurricanes’ Bruce Brown Jr. will test NBA Draft waters|url=https://www.foxsports.com/florida/story/miami-hurricanes-bruce-brown-jr-will-test-nba-draft-waters-032218|accessdate=April 2, 2018|work=Fox Sports|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=March 22, 2018}} Brown ultimately decided to stay in the draft.{{cite news |title=Hurricanes' Dewan Huell opts out of NBA draft, returning for junior season
